pr_title: fix: toBeFocused should match shadow elements

issue_context.title: [BUG] toBeFocused() matcher isn't piercing Shadow DOM
issue_context.body:
**Context:**
- Playwright Version: [1.24.2]
- Operating System: [Mac]
- Node.js version: [16.13.2]
- Browser: [any]
- Extra: []

**Code Snippet**

Unfortunately I have a web component built with Svelte and it will be hard to include it all, but the gist is:

Web component named `<my-switch>` with a control inside of it `<input>`. The only element with focus is the `<input>` in this component, e.g:

```
<my-switch>
   shadowroot
      <input />
<my-switch>
```

```javascript
    await page.locator('my-switch  input').focus();
    await expect(page.locator('my-switch')).toBeFocused(); // passes but it isn't really focused
    await expect(page.locator('my-switch input')).toBeFocused(); // fails assertion but it is focused
```

When I run in headed mode and pause after focus() is run,
`document.activeElement` returns `my-switch` element.
`document.activeElement.shadowRoot.activeElement` returns `input` element.

This is because input is really what has focus, but the browser doesn't pierce the shadow DOM. 

**Describe the bug**

It appears Playwright is not piercing shadow DOM for this matcher and is returning the parent element within the browser's DOM that is focused. Playwright does a great job piercing shadow DOM for other functionality, I'd expect toBeFocused to also pierce shadow DOM to get the right focused element.

Call log:
```
      - expect.toBeFocused with timeout 5000ms
      - waiting for selector "input"
      -   selector resolved to <input type="checkbox" id="50260257-8885-4b84-b894-8d6b…/>
      -   unexpected value "false"
      -   selector resolved to <input type="checkbox" id="50260257-8885-4b84-b894-8d6b…/>
      -   unexpected value "false"
```
comments: Thanks for the report. I've opened a PR, but I need to review with the team to sort out expectations with the team. In some ways—depending on the perspective—I think both should report focused. However, it may be worth making the expectation explicit in our API instead of the implicit patch I made. Follow the PR for updates! Thanks!
